_comment: Each hero rolls two survival skills. Rank 1-3, gained by use (rank_xp). passive: applies while any living party member has the skill; value = base + per_rank * (rank - 1). Camp actions cost hours from the camp budget; each hero may use each action once per camp. Camp effect types: heal_pct, fatigue, food, money, timber, iron, item, wagon, reveal, no_ambush, next_fight_buff, clear_shaken, recruit_chance. target: self, ally, party. Numbers scale per rank via per_rank. unlock: the survival rank needed to use the action (a new hero has one action per skill). cost: supplies used ({item: count}).

cook.name: Cook
cook.desc: Makes beans and bacon taste like Sunday dinner.

actions.name: Hearty Stew
actions.desc: A big pot of beans, bacon and whatever's handy. Uses Food.

actions.name: Trail Coffee
actions.desc: Strong, bitter and hot. Uses Food (the coffee ration).

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: Can bring down a pronghorn at three hundred yards.

actions.name: Go Hunting
actions.desc: Brings back food, and sometimes a hide. Might come back empty-handed.

actions.name: Stalker's Eye
actions.desc: Party gains Accuracy for the next fight.

forager.name: Forager
forager.desc: Knows which roots feed you and which kill you.

passive.text: Chance to find food at trail stops

actions.name: Forage
actions.desc: Gathers food, and sometimes herbs for bandages or antivenom.

actions.name: Wild Herb Poultice
actions.desc: Heals one hero.

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Rides ahead and comes back with news.

passive.text: Much better odds of seeing what lies ahead on the map

actions.name: Scout Ahead
actions.desc: Rides ahead and identifies the nearest unscouted stops.

actions.name: Night Watch
actions.desc: No ambush tonight; better odds of surprising the next enemies.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.desc: Reads bent grass and broken twigs like a printed page.

passive.text: Harder to surprise, surprises enemies more often, and reads who's waiting at spotted fights

actions.name: Read the Sign
actions.desc: Studies the tracks ahead: identifies the nearest unknown stops, and the party knows what to aim for in the next fight.

actions.name: Cover Tracks
actions.desc: No ambush tonight, and the party rests easier.

wheelwright.name: Wheelwright
wheelwright.desc: Can build a wagon wheel from a fence and a prayer.

actions.name: Mend the Wagon
actions.desc: Repairs the wagon.

actions.name: Salvage Parts
actions.desc: Turns 2 Timber into Wagon Parts (free at rank 3).

medic.name: Medic
medic.desc: Sewed up soldiers in the war. Steady hands.

actions.name: Field Dressing
actions.desc: Clean, stitch and bind a wound. Uses a Bandage.

actions.name: Set the Bone
actions.desc: Cures Shaken (Last Legs recovery) and heals a little.

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.desc: Knows a tale for every campfire, and most of them are even true.

actions.name: Tall Tales
actions.desc: Party sheds Fatigue.

actions.name: Rousing Tune
actions.desc: Harmonica by the fire. Party gains Dodge for the next fight and sheds a little Fatigue.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.desc: Runs a trap line and knows what a good pelt is worth.

actions.name: Set Snares
actions.desc: Catches food overnight, now and then a pelt worth keeping.

actions.name: Tan Pelts
actions.desc: Scrapes, salts and tans the pelts: Hides for town, and a few chips.

angler.name: Angler
angler.desc: Can find a fish in a mud puddle.

passive.text: Knows the fords: river crossings go better

actions.name: Go Fishing
actions.desc: Catches food. Relaxing, too.

actions.name: Quiet Water
actions.desc: Takes a friend fishing. They shed a lot of Fatigue.

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.desc: Fells a cottonwood in twenty swings.

actions.name: Fell Timber
actions.desc: Cuts Timber for the settlements.

actions.name: Big Bonfire
actions.desc: A roaring fire. Party heals a little and sheds Fatigue.

miner.name: Miner
miner.desc: Can smell ore through six feet of rock.

actions.name: Prospect
actions.desc: Digs for Iron, sometimes finds a little gold.

actions.name: Dig In
actions.desc: Dig foxholes and breastworks. Party gains Protection for the next fight.
